title: YouTube comments on the Dwarkesh Podcast episode with Ajeya Cotra, "This might be the clearest warning shot we ever get"
artefact_title: Ajeya Cotra – "This might be the clearest warning shot we ever get" (Dwarkesh Podcast)
central_claim: The incident is real, accurately described, and a serious warning about losing control of AI agents.
capture_method: yt-dlp --write-comments, complete export with threading, like counts and timestamps (approximate for older comments). Second capture; the first (8 September, page capture, 1,249 comments) is not on file.

spot_check.note: Random 40-comment sample (with parent text for replies) checked against the codebook on stance, frame, format reaction and emotion; 40/40 agreed, no corrections.

coders: Claude (claude-fable-5-1), sixteen parallel coders of about 188 comments each, parent comment text supplied for replies

changelog.note: Page capture, 1,249 of 1,569 comments, coded with an earlier frame list; article published from it. Files not archived.
Complete yt-dlp capture (2,999 comments) recoded against a redrafted 18-frame list with the series' full five-dimension scheme. Supersedes v1.

licence: CC BY 4.0 (coding and compilation; comment text remains its authors')
notes: 'other' carries 13% of comments, mostly long off-topic reply chains (European politics, transhumanism and religion, commenter-on-commenter arguments) with no position on the incident. Frame-level comparison with v1 is directional only; stance, format reaction and emotion use the fixed series categories and are comparable.
